decisions.evidence: R4 maker: saving 'starts with a prominent address field' producing a card; R4 client: 'pasting the address and getting back the title, the site name, the description ... exactly the kind of thing I hoped for.'
decisions.note: Foundational save-by-url presented conformingly and approved; conforms to REF-BM-01 (prototype review).

decisions.evidence: R4 maker card image 'is just a placeholder'; R4 client: 'The image area here is just a placeholder — I'd want a real preview picture of the page when there is one.' R5 maker delivers a real representative picture.
decisions.note: Presented auto-save underfilled REF-BM-02's preview-image collection (placeholder, not collected preview); client supplied the reference-conforming behavior → correct (prototype review).

decisions.evidence: R4 client: 'I'll sometimes want to fix the title or description if the automatic one is off — I don't see a way to do that yet, so I'd like to check that later'; maker defers, R6 demonstrates in-place edit, client approves.
decisions.note: Client surfaced editing missing from the R4 auto-save scope → extend; deferral linked to R6 disposition, one decision (prototype review).

decisions.evidence: R6 client: 'I'd also want to be able to change the actual web address if I pasted the wrong one'; R8 maker demonstrates address-correction flow.
decisions.note: URL editing missing from R6's title/description edit scope; client requested this reference requirement → extend (prototype review).

decisions.evidence: R6 client: 'there should be a way to get rid of a bookmark entirely when I don't want it anymore'; R28 maker demonstrates permanent deletion.
decisions.note: Delete surfaced by client ahead of any presentation → extend; resolved R28 (prototype review).

decisions.evidence: R2 client: 'if I try to save something I've already saved, I'd rather it just take me to the one I already have instead of making a duplicate'; R27/R38 maker demonstrate duplicate + equivalent-address handling.
decisions.note: Client surfaced dedup-to-existing before any presentation → extend (goal stage → prototype review).

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'put labels on them so I can pull up, say, everything about cooking'; R10/R11 maker demonstrate tag assignment.
decisions.note: Client articulated tag assignment as a requirement ahead of presentation → extend (goal stage → prototype review).

decisions.evidence: R10 maker Version A adds labels one-at-a-time with no autocomplete (Version B teased); R10 client: 'when I start typing a label, I want it to suggest ones I've already used ... I'd want the two combined'; R11 delivers combined autocomplete.
decisions.note: Offered alternatives differ in REF-BM-10 fulfilment (A lacks autocomplete, B has it); client selects the autocomplete-conforming alternative → select, diverged=true (prototype review).

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'pull up ... everything about cooking, or everything I tagged for work'; R12 maker demonstrates label-filter list with counts.
decisions.note: Client surfaced filter-by-tag ahead of presentation → extend (goal stage → prototype review).

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'a real search that looks inside everything I've saved, not just the titles'; R13 maker demonstrates full-content search finding text inside the saved page.
decisions.note: Client explicitly specified full-content search ahead of presentation → extend (goal stage → prototype review).

decisions.evidence: R13 client: 'It shouldn't care about capital letters — searching "flexbox" or "Flexbox" should find the same thing'; R14 maker confirms case-insensitive match.
decisions.note: Case-insensitivity missing from R13's basic full-text ask; client requested it → extend (prototype review).

decisions.evidence: R13 client: 'search by one of my labels directly, something like typing #cooking'; R15 maker demonstrates #tag search.
decisions.note: #tag search missing from R13 scope; client requested it → extend (prototype review).

decisions.evidence: R13 client: 'combine things ... either cooking or weekend'; R17 client: 'spell out "and," "or," and "not" myself ... even grouping ... if I were literally searching for the word "and" ... treated as a plain word'; R18-R22 demonstrate NOT/AND/grouping/literal. R19 client caught the AND screen had not actually executed; R20 shows the executed result.
decisions.note: Boolean operators, parentheses and the literal-operator quoting rule all surfaced by client → extend; R19 clarification linked to R20 disposition, not double-counted (prototype review).

decisions.evidence: R13 client: 'put it in quotes and have it match just that phrase rather than the loose words'; R16 maker demonstrates quoted exact-phrase match.
decisions.note: Quoted-phrase exact match missing from R13 scope; client requested it → extend (prototype review).

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'a "read later" pile ... keep those separate and check them off as I go'; R23 (mark read→Finished), R24 (add to read-later at save), R39 (empty queue) demonstrate.
decisions.note: Client surfaced mark-as-unread, separate unread view, and mark-read-removal ahead of presentation → extend (goal stage → prototype review).

decisions.evidence: R41 client: 'select a bunch of them and, say, add a label to all of them, or archive them together, instead of doing each one'; R46/R47 demonstrate bulk label and bulk archive.
decisions.note: Bulk actions surfaced at the spec gate before build → extend (specification gate → prototype review).

decisions.evidence: R46 maker: '"Select all shown" applies only to the current filtered result—not hidden bookmarks elsewhere'; R46 client: '"Select all shown" clearly means just the four I'm looking at'.
decisions.note: Maker-introduced scope-limiting detail conforms to REF-BM-21 (bulk limited to current filter); approved without a surfaced difference (prototype review).

decisions.evidence: R41 client: 'I'd want to change the order — newest first, or by title'; R45 maker demonstrates sort within the current view.
decisions.note: Sort surfaced at the spec gate before build → extend (specification gate → prototype review).

decisions.evidence: R25 client: 'a little formatting — a couple of bullet points or a bit of emphasis — and to have it show up nicely formatted'; R26 maker demonstrates formatted-note save/render.
decisions.note: Plain-note presentation at R25 lacked markdown; client requested rich formatting/rendering = REF-BM-23 essence → extend (prototype review).

decisions.evidence: R33 client: 'keep its own copy of what the page said ... almost like a snapshot ... if the thing I saved is one of those PDF documents ... I'd want the actual document itself kept'; R34/R35 demonstrate HTML snapshot and stored PDF.
decisions.note: Client specified page snapshot and the PDF-store rule (REF-BM-24 edge) → extend (prototype review).

decisions.evidence: R28 client: 'tuck it out of sight, out of my main list and search, but still keep it so I can bring it back later. That's different from this permanent delete ... I'd want both'; R29 client: 'going into that Archived list ... bring it back'; R29/R30 demonstrate archive + restore.
decisions.note: Client surfaced reversible archiving, its distinction from permanent delete, and the separate archived view → extend (prototype review).

decisions.evidence: R41 client: 'A search I keep coming back to ... I'd love to save so I can pull it up again with one click'; R48 client also: 'remember the search itself, not a frozen snapshot'; R48/R49 demonstrate stored-query saved search.
decisions.note: Saved-search/bundle surfaced at spec gate, plus the living-query requirement at R48 → extend (specification gate → prototype review).

decisions.evidence: R41 client: 'bring those in when I first set this up, rather than re-saving hundreds of links by hand'; R42 client extends: 'each one keeps its original name and the date I first bookmarked it'; R42/R43 demonstrate import preserving titles/dates.
decisions.note: Import surfaced at spec gate; client further required title/date preservation (REF-BM-30 rule) missing from the R42 presentation → extend (specification gate → prototype review).

decisions.evidence: R41 client: 'to be able to take mine back out again if I ever wanted to'; R44 maker demonstrates browser-compatible (Netscape) export with titles/dates/folders.
decisions.note: Export surfaced at the spec gate before build → extend (specification gate → prototype review).

decisions.evidence: R41 client: 'a couple of small personal preferences, like how many show at once or the default order and text size'; R50 maker demonstrates preferences (items shown, default order, text size).
decisions.note: Display preferences surfaced at the spec gate before build → extend (specification gate → prototype review).

decisions.evidence: R40 maker: two-line preview, first two labels plus remainder count, full content on demand; R40 client: 'the cards stay tidy ... the first two labels with a little "+6" ... nothing's actually hidden from me.'
decisions.note: Maker-introduced readability-first list design conforms to REF-BM-07; approved without a surfaced difference (prototype review).
